content.title: When the Epic Games servers are down, how can I find out when they'll be back up? - Technical Support
content.text: Sign in (Opens in a new tab) to get faster help, access self-service tools, and manage your support requests.When the Epic Games servers are down, how can I find out when they'll be back up?You can check the Epic Games Public Statuses (Opens in a new tab) to see if a server is down or under maintenance and when it will be back online. If no timeframe is listed on the statuses page, please continue monitoring it to see when the server is back online. Player Support doesn't have additional information on server outages. If you're experiencing connection issues and there is no server outage, please check out How to troubleshoot connection issuesWas this article helpful?YesNoContact usEpic Support AssistantBy continuing, you agree to our Terms (Opens in a new tab) and acknowledge our Privacy Policy (Opens in a new tab).
